policy: Do not populate from a list of known winners. Case IDs must be anonymous, inputs must come from independently assembled time-bounded multi-coin cohorts. All evaluator outcomes stay outside role-visible storage.
blocked_reason: No independently source-attested historical multi-coin dataset and 50 verified non-overlapping evaluation windows have been staged. Existing PEPE-only known-winner data are NOT blind eligible.
